benchmark.construction: mean net return of that as_of's constituents with a tradable T+1 entry, same adjusted series, session count and cost model as the members
benchmark.name: equal_weight
benchmark.note: computed from stored bars; not a published index. Members of the cross-section that could not be priced are excluded from the mean

guard.note: calibration_status is never changed by this tool; the report only says whether the observed sample is sufficient to consider a future, separately reviewed calibration change

lookahead_check.rule: every scoring input date must be <= its as_of (Asia/Shanghai)

market_data.adjust_fallback: raw when no backward series is stored

coverage.note: sessions are the sorted union of stored market bars; a stock's own suspension does not shorten its horizon
